children: RNS Number : 2699V  Henderson Far East Income Limited  17 September 2026
JANUS HENDERSON FUND MANAGEMENT UK LIMITED
The Company announces that it agreed on 17 September 2026 to allot 425,000 ordinary shares at a price of 266.5p per share.
These shares will be issued for cash on 18 September 2026, bringing the issued share capital and total voting rights at that date to 234,479,679.
Janus Henderson Secretarial Services UK Limited
